{
  "name": "marketing-report-studio",
  "private": true,
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "node scripts/build.mjs",
    "e2e": "node tests/e2e-smoke.mjs",
    "e2e:strict": "node scripts/run-e2e-strict.mjs",
    "qa:assets": "node tests/hosted-assets-smoke.mjs",
    "qa:charts": "node tests/chart-registry-smoke.mjs",
    "qa:documents": "node tests/document-adapters-smoke.mjs",
    "qa:large": "node tests/large-data-smoke.mjs",
    "qa:pdf": "node scripts/qa-local-fixtures.mjs tests/fixtures/pdf",
    "qa:pdf:strict": "node scripts/qa-local-fixtures.mjs tests/fixtures/pdf --strict",
    "test:agent": "python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_agent.py' -v",
    "qa:scale": "node tests/performance-storage-smoke.mjs",
    "qa:xlsx": "node tests/xlsx-styles-smoke.mjs",
    "qa:xlsx:regions": "node tests/xlsx-regions-smoke.mjs",
    "test": "node tests/api-smoke.mjs && node tests/worker-smoke.mjs && node tests/config-and-ui-smoke.mjs && node tests/ui-smoke.mjs && node tests/universal-analysis-smoke.mjs && node tests/chart-registry-smoke.mjs && node tests/performance-storage-smoke.mjs && node tests/pdf-fixtures-smoke.mjs && node tests/hosted-assets-smoke.mjs && node tests/xlsx-styles-smoke.mjs && node tests/xlsx-regions-smoke.mjs && node tests/document-adapters-smoke.mjs && node tests/provider-result-adapter-smoke.mjs && node tests/provider-markdown-smoke.mjs && node tests/provider-result-app-integration-smoke.mjs",
    "check": "npm run build && npm test && npm run e2e",
    "check:strict": "npm run build && npm test && npm run test:agent && npm run qa:pdf:strict && npm run e2e:strict"
  }
}
